general.description: NASA CRM wing-body (5th AIAA Drag Prediction Workshop, case 1), SA-noft2: M 0.85, alpha 2.3 deg, Re 5e6 per mean aerodynamic chord

domain.notes: The workshop's common multi-block structured grids (5 blocks, O-O; data/grids/README.md), in inches, scaled by 1/275.80 to mean aerodynamic chords. Patches by box rules: the symmetry plane y = 0, the aircraft inside a box round it, the far field (about 115 chords away) for the rest. Reference area (half model, 297,360 in^2), chord and moment centre (1325.90, 0, 177.95 in) as the workshop defines them.

freestream.notes: The workshop's case is at CL = 0.500; 2.3 deg is an estimate of that angle. Reference temperature 100 F.
